name: Sichuan Swellfun Co.,Ltd
summary: Sichuan Swellfun Co.,Ltd engages in the production and sale of liquor and wine in China and internationally. The company offers products, such as First Distillery, Shui Jing Fang Dynasty Collections, Shui Jing Fang Forest Green, Shui Jing Fang Classics, Shui Jing Fang Wellbay, Shui Jing Fang No. 8, Shui Jing Fang Wellbay Collection, Shui Jing Fang Red Fortune, Four Gentlemen, Xiao Shui Jing, THC, and Shui Jing Fu. It is also involved in manufacturing of beverages and refined tea. Sichuan Swellfun Co.,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
